artifact.question: Does the verified three-surface frozen candidate have a coherent source/PRD/prior-handoff baseline and complete stage-aware claim/evidence inventory?

independence.system_prompt_id: Inherited runtime system/developer instructions; provider identifier or hash not introspected
independence.source_set: Frozen PASS01 artifact and local source resources; actual saved pinned/retained images inspected before backlog and current technical/adjudication claims
independence.permissions: No artifact editing, modeling, native regeneration, dependencies, children or remote writes
independence.shared_model_limit: Inherited configured model may be shared with other reviewers; exact identity unknown
independence.shared_source_history_limit: Shared project goal, pinned sources and prior development history; required goal and a lightweight historical memory search preceded image observations. Separate role/context does not make this blind.
independence.acceptance_limit: Analytical judgments of saved images do not become blind owner acceptance, unseen generalization or outcome uplift evidence

material_findings.claim: The roadmap's strongest next goal is a coherent connected head rather than another small crown-tone loop.
material_findings.evidence: The retained crown reads as a smooth pale helmet over detached dark spikes, optic as a prominent external ring, and cheek/bill join as a large dark void with smooth rails. The pinned source connects layered crown, deeper brow/optic and compact cheek/bill construction. Tasks name these parts, preserve stance/body gains, require whole-bird views and stop after two designs without gain.
material_findings.consequence: Tiny surface variants could consume another budget without closing the features that define source identity.
material_findings.next_test: Under newly selected scope, compare one integrated head successor to exact locked full-body and July head-only references at the same candidate camera/light, with complete bird and head close-ups within 15–30 minutes.

material_findings.claim: The inventory retains all 52 PRD IDs and F01–F10 with useful current-stage and conditional-phase task links.
material_findings.evidence: Independent source-table extraction found exactly 52 PRD IDs with no absent or extra mapped IDs. F01–F10 are all present. All dependency targets exist and the task graph has no cycles. V12/B01–B11 motion is conditional, inspection scope stays distinct, and mechanics/fitment requires separate authority. These structural checks confirm coverage, not criterion attainment.
material_findings.consequence: Without stage distinctions the static GLBs could be mistaken for a full-product pass or historical unknowns for new observed failures.
material_findings.next_test: At each future task closure, inspect the exact task-specific artifact and applicable PRD retest; preserve NOT RUN/UNKNOWN and do not close F01–F10 from code or map presence alone.

material_findings.claim: The roadmap preserves useful retained features while honestly leaving whole-character likeness and era finish distinction open.
material_findings.evidence: Saved views visibly retain layered breast courses and segmented toes. Maker and Mechanic remain visually similar in neutral retained views, while Advanced differs clearly through its orange optic; source era finishes have stronger fabrication/age/repair differentiation. The draft carries all three loop gains and does not reuse historical numerical scores as current evidence. I did not inspect a matched before/after series, so the amount of net gain remains supplied historical evidence.
material_findings.consequence: Losing retained gains or treating a common color filter as era identity would cause rework and false acceptance.
material_findings.next_test: MB-T015 matched checkpoint-to-successor sheets plus all-era regional/whole-bird comparisons under both controlled lights, followed by exact owner-scoped artistic decisions.

material_findings.claim: The tasks are actionable proposals, but worker accountability must become an explicit dispatch prerequisite.
material_findings.evidence: All 62 tasks contain dependencies, closure evidence, proposed caps, preservation conditions, status refresh rules and owner role types. MB-T062 requires a named contributor/deadline/accounting/stop ledger before dispatch. Most tasks still name generic role types and omit concrete owned files; MB-T001's dependency array does not include MB-T062. This is sufficient for a proposal inventory, but must not be treated as a ready worker assignment.
material_findings.consequence: An integrator could dispatch the attractive head work before operational caps, contributor boundaries and stop responsibility exist.
material_findings.next_test: Make MB-T062 an explicit series-wide prerequisite, then freeze a concise selected-task assignment ledger with named owner, exact input/output paths and allowed files, independent QC owner, deadline, shared cap and concrete interrupt/stop action.

material_findings.claim: Current stage delivery is recorded separately from artistic and animated-product acceptance, with remaining evidence limits visible.
material_findings.evidence: The frozen surface record names production revision 109e9e7, exact GitHub/Pages receipt identifiers, private Replit selected-port limits and Notion readback, while the backlog closes MB-T029 with limits. Static assessment GLBs remain distinct from V37 acting/inspection. Strict normal failure, shader/pixel parity unknowns, absent holdout and owner PENDING remain visible. I reviewed supplied receipts' summary record and did not repeat live remote checks.
material_findings.consequence: A synchronized assessment could be misreported as full artistic, animation, portability or shader parity acceptance.
material_findings.next_test: Use exact live receipts for publication claims; preserve source-goal UNMET/owner PENDING until owner review. Any uplift or protected-holdout release claim must defer for evidence.

material_findings.claim: A few draft instructions remain stale after the frozen delivery and should be refreshed for reader use.
material_findings.evidence: The purpose says review follows synchronization and MB-T029 is closed, but next_root_action still starts with updating final main/Pages/Replit/Notion freeze/readbacks, and PARENT_DELIVERY still describes assignment-time pending delivery. The latter is historical context, but that status is not labeled as clearly as current_snapshot.
material_findings.consequence: A continuation reader may spend time repeating completed remote writes or misreport the release as still pending.
material_findings.next_test: Label PARENT_DELIVERY historical/transient and rewrite next_root_action around the already frozen receipts, completion of five separate review records and selected next-goal decision.

assumptions: Pinned image hashes were checked against the freeze; all matched. July body/long wings and workshop props are excluded from this judgment.
Per-era source and retained images differ in lighting/camera; qualitative finish diagnosis does not supply calibrated numerical error.
No peer reports, protected holdout or external independent model family were available to this role.
No live renderer, native probe, shader replay, motion/contact, human accessibility, physical device or sustained performance testing was performed.
release_conditions: Approve only the scoped analytical roadmap baseline; source goal UNMET and owner PENDING remain.
Before dispatch, make MB-T062 a series-wide prerequisite and freeze named owner/file boundary/QC/cap/stop accountability for the selected subset.
Refresh the stale continuation action and explicitly historical assignment snapshot.
Root completes all five distinct successive pass records and correct conditional disruptor/adjudication decisions before claiming five-pass completion.
No current release, modeling, mechanics, paid Replit or dependency authority is granted by this review.
smallest_correction: Add one series-wide dispatch prerequisite linking MB-T062, require selected-task owned-file/contributor ledger, and refresh two stale continuation labels. No model or roadmap-wide rewrite is required.
review_expiry_trigger: Any candidate/reference/runtime/source hash change, new owner canon decision, changed surface receipt or selected work scope requires scoped refresh.
notes: The frozen backlog serves the owner as a useful, comprehensive stage-aware gap inventory. It identifies visually dominant source failures, protects retained work and proposes bounded closure evidence. Approval is limited to roadmap usefulness and coverage; complete likeness, five-pass completion and protected-holdout outcome claims remain unproved.
